Hi Jess, 
my brother (20) and I (23) have just arrived in Australia and recently found jobs in Brisbane.
The location would be perfect for us, as it’s close to our workplace and would make commuting easy.
We’re looking for a shared flat with a relaxed, friendly vibe and enjoy living with other people in a respectful and easy-going environment.
We’re clean, tidy, reliable, and considerate flatmates  not big party people, but always up for a good chat.
We’re planning to work long-term in Brisbane and would love to find a place where we feel comfortable and settled.
Happy to share more details or come by for an inspection anytime!
